_note: FL40 fragment: non-bitfield gates (items, form, counters). '_stateGates' is the stateGates section the FL40 task asks for; `npm run flags` rejects an unprefixed 'stateGates' key (top level accepts flags, proposals, domains; _ and $ keys are ignored), so the section is underscore-prefixed until the tool is extended. Sites are written as file:line {ROM offset}. Item ids are hex; names come from system_strings.item_name_table. 'key' = the item is tested by BranchIfHasItem / BranchIfItemEquipped or by its use handler to gate a door, NPC or scene.
